content.text: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/25

It seems like a good thing to update the spring schema version, but it does not appear to fix the issue described in fcrepo-1670. I would note that the spring configuration for fcrepo-webapp also uses version 3.0 schema declarations, and those don't seem to cause problems for jetty-maven.
Have you tested with the PR, and with the removal of your added dependencies for the Jetty Maven plugin?
yes I have. (On a mac with the added deps removed, and with
PR applied to fcrepo-webapp-plus – on top of the fcrepo-1670 branch)
But there was never any problem building on a Mac. Why would that show any change?
The build failed earlier on a mac without the added deps (that's why they were added in the first place).
Per
http://irclogs.fcrepo.org/2015-09-29.html
we are going to remove the added deps and (re)start from there.
is your PR based off of
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/25
is not based on
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/22
: The following PR has been updated based on code review comments:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/25
Merged to master via
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/commit/080e5132d76cfa590e2a52f779f429c420b3b07c

fcrepo-webapp-plus is using the wrong version of various Spring schemata in its XML wiring, for example in src/rbacl/webapp/WEB-INF/classes/spring/auth-repo.xml. It is using 3 when it should be using 4. This is causing problems using it in various deployments, particularly with Jetty's Maven plugin for integration tests.
